def get_input():
    res = 0
    neg = False
    ch = input()
    while not ch.isdigit() and ch != '-':
        ch = input()
    if ch == '-':
        neg = True
        ch = input()
    while ch.isdigit():
        res = res * 10 + int(ch)
        ch = input()
    return -res if neg else res

def main():
    n = get_input()
    base = get_input()
    MAXK = 31
    MOD = 1000000007

    digits = []
    while n > 0:
        digits.append(n % base)
        n //= base
    digits.reverse()
    length = len(digits)

    # Initialize matrices
    A = [[[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(70)]
    pre = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
    suf = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
    ans = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
    I = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]

    def initialize_identity():
        for i in range(base + 1):
            for j in range(base + 1):
                I[i][j] = 0
        for i in range(base + 1):
            I[i][i] = 1

    def matrix_multiply(A1, B, R):
        C = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
        for i in range(base + 1):
            for k in range(base + 1):
                for j in range(base + 1):
                    C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A1[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD
        for i in range(base + 1):
            for j in range(base + 1):
                R[i][j] = C[i][j]

    def setup_matrices():
        for i in range(base):
            for j in range(base + 1):
                A[0][i][j] = 0
            A[0][i][i] = 1
            A[0][i][0] = 1
        for i in range(1, length):
            for j in range(base + 1):
                for k in range(base + 1):
                    pre[j][k] = 0
            for j in range(base):
                for k in range(base + 1):
                    pre[j][k] = A[i - 1][0][k]
            for j in range(1, base):
                matrix_multiply(A[i - 1][j], pre[j - 1], pre[j])
            for j in range(base + 1):
                for k in range(base + 1):
                    suf[j][k] = 0
            for j in range(base + 1):
                for k in range(base + 1):
                    suf[base - 1][k] = A[i - 1][base - 1][k]
            for j in range(base - 2, -1, -1):
                matrix_multiply(suf[j + 1], A[i - 1][j], suf[j])
            for j in range(base):
                if j > 0:
                    matrix_multiply(pre[j - 1], suf[j], A[i][j])
                else:
                    for k in range(base + 1):
                        for l in range(base + 1):
                            I[k][l] = 0
                    for k in range(base + 1):
                        I[k][k] = 1
                    matrix_multiply(I, suf[j], A[i][j])

    initialize_identity()
    setup_matrices()

    answer = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
    for i in range(base + 1):
        answer[i][0] = 1 if i == 0 else 0

    x = 0
    for i in range(length - 1, -1, -1):
        for j in range(digits[i]):
            matrix_multiply(A[i][(j + x) % base], answer, answer)
        x = (x + digits[i]) % base

    res = 0
    for i in range(base):
        res = (res + answer[i][0]) % MOD
    print(res + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
